title: pteris pallens
intro: Pteris pallens, commonly known as the slender bracken fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which can help to alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Pteris pallens include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-hyperlipidemic activities, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Pteris pallens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
